title: Tastile agent execution checkpoint
description: Structured snapshot of an in-flight agent task. Re-usable for both soft (local) and hard (remote-durable) checkpoint boundaries. See ADR-0008.

schema_version.description: Schema version (semver-like). Older checkpoints accept schema_version <= backward_compat.

backward_compat.description: Optional array of older schema_version strings this checkpoint is still readable against.

issue_id.description: GitHub Issue number (positive integer) as a string. Empty string only when the task is pre-Issue (planning, design freeze).

target_release.description: Canonical release branch ADR-0007 defines. Empty when ticket targets main directly.

ticket_branch.description: Per ADR-0007 the ticket branch name is the GitHub Issue number only (digits). Empty when no Issue yet.

pr_number.description: GitHub PR number when one exists, otherwise omitted.

base_sha.description: 40-character hex commit SHA the agent started from.

checkpoint_sha_or_snapshot.description: 40-character hex commit SHA, or an absolute filesystem path of a tar / tar.gz soft-checkpoint blob.

execution_generation.description: Monotonic counter incremented on every recovery. 1 for the first attempt.

status.description: Checkpoint lifecycle status. This enum is distinct from child result verdict, external operation result, and recovery report STATUS.

fencing_token.description: Opaque token issued by the parent. Must NOT be reused across siblings.

last_heartbeat.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent heartbeat from the child.

external_side_effects.description: Side effects whose retry semantics need an idempotency key. Required for any state mutation that survives process death.

target.description: Stable identifier for the external resource (e.g. release tag, PR number, file path).

observed_state.description: Snapshot of the remote state at last observation (tag SHA, PR head SHA, build number, etc.).

decision_refs.description: Paths to ADRs / design docs / Skills referenced by this checkpoint. ADRs are preferred.

artifact_refs.description: Relative or absolute file paths or remote URLs to artifacts the task produced.

rpo_seconds.description: Hard-checkpoint recovery point objective (only set on hard checkpoints).

rto_seconds.description: Hard-checkpoint recovery time objective (only set on hard checkpoints).

last_hard_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent successful hard checkpoint.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent edit to this checkpoint.

allOf.description: Hard-checkpoint extension fields must be set together.
